experiment_kind: paper methods restored on pinned modern author code

video.selection: all fig4; seed 0 and lowest-index failed and successful table1 episodes for each method, without cutting

implementation_choices: Paper gives no numerical Q/R/covariance, duty factor, control rate, friction, or episode duration. Use pinned author's nominal Q/R, covariance scales, 100 Hz MPC, 500 Hz physics, 0.65 duty factor and 60 s batch default. No parameter search.

Paper says 21 kg; both pinned modern and historical author configuration say approximately 24.638 kg. Keep actual MJCF and measure total mass/inertia from initial pose for both controllers; do not rescale only the optimizer.

Naive fixed mixture of three Gaussians follows V-A multiple-Gaussian description and Algorithm 3. Modern author's third uniform component replaced by Gaussian at the same configured scale. Retain previous mean as one candidate.
Enable force tracking cost in sampling per V; match nominal acados force weights. Mask nominal stance load on swing legs. Same first 12 Q weights for all controllers.
Disable foothold optimization, integrators, external wrench compensation, reflexes, velocity modulation, gradient refinement, Riccati feedback, and OT-MPC.
Use original Eq 3 instantaneous foothold velocity correction, without modern 5 cm clipping. Use existing cubic swing generator and low-level torque mapping.
Correct adaptive prediction contact phase to begin at current phase, as non-adaptive execution does. Frequency updates at swing apex follow historical author implementation.
Figure 4 uses explicit world-y 0.1 m/s command, world-y 40 N push at 2<=t<5 s (3 s caption). Text instead says around 2 to 4.2 s; plot axes suggest forward motion not explained by text.

Table I does not specify episode duration, command, wrench schedule or failure threshold. Use 60 s author batch default, figure 3 0.5 m/s command and 2 s wrench holds, fixed declared failure limits plus environment termination. Exact numerical reproduction cannot be claimed.
Reported paper success 37 percent is incompatible with 50 integer Bernoulli episodes. Preserve integer outcomes; do not force match.
Paper Mean Cost/tracking error scalar is not fully defined. Report linear-velocity error norm (m/s), RMSE, integrated quadratic state/input cost and success counts separately.
JIT compilation first solve is retained in raw data and separated from steady-state solve-time boxplot; no dummy warm-up runs.
